newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Nov 12.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories on Tuesday:
- HFS Inc will acquire PHH Corp in a stock deal worth about $1.7 billion.
- Bergen Brunswig Corp is to buy IVAX Corp for $1.66 billion in stock.
- Sunbeam Corp is expected to announce plans to make cuts and lay offs on Tuesday.
- A commission of 30 prominent corporate executives and shareholders released a list of recommendations to make standards tougher for being on a board of directors.
- The accounting industry is expected to adopt on Tuesday new standards to clarify the auditor's role in detecting fraud.
- The Semiconductor Industry Association reported a book-to-bill ratio of 1.10, up from a revised figure of 0.98 in September.
- Ford Motor Co began offering warranty program for used cars from its dealers.
- Lehman Brothers is going back to merchant banking and setting out to raise as much as $1.5 billion for private equity investments.
- Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto announced a plan to create a financial center to rival New York and London by the next century.
- Discount retailer Wal-Mart Stores Inc is changing pop culture as it censors music sold in its stores.
- Continental Airlines President Gordon Bethune has managed to turn the airline around since he assumed the position three years ago.
